tools.name: get_coin_profile

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: create_free_api_key, check_key_status, resend_verification_email, get_exchange_links · Private data: create_free_api_key, check_key_status, get_exchange_links, list_capabilities · Public sink: create_free_api_key, check_key_status, resend_verification_email.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: create_free_api_key, check_key_status, resend_verification_email, get_exchange_links · Private data: create_free_api_key, check_key_status, get_exchange_links, list_capabilities · Public sink: create_free_api_key, check_key_status, resend_verification_email

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
